visual_thesis: Scientific-agent trust depends on inspectable method and access as well as a correct result.
mechanism_metaphor: A single long translucent research-record prism rises diagonally from lower left to upper right. Expose its internal five unequal facets rather than three disconnected stations. Validation at lower left faces Source papers, Objectivity at lower center faces Conflicting evidence, Transparency near the middle opens to Method record, Privacy on the right shows an Authorized files compartment beside an inaccessible compartment with no arrow crossing, and Accountability at upper right faces Human responsibility. No human icon or checkmark. A single source-supported arrow travels from the Source papers object to the Method record object, representing evidence verification as part of inspectable research, not a claim of automatic truth. Noncausal callout leaders have no heads. A detached upper-left note reads 17 interviews; exploratory. Every content surface has an exact informative term or a distinct access state; no fake scientific text or anonymous layers counted as evidence. Meaning at mobile width: inspect how the result was made and which files were accessed, not just the result.
